t: Lightweight and portable compressor for long term performance. Features easy-start motor, anti-vibration foot, easy-adjust regulator and easy-drain valve. Suitable for DIY and light trade applications. Supplied with spiral hose, blow gun, inflating gun, gravity spray gun and a spray nozzle gun.
b: Compatible with All Stanley Air Tools
Effortless Inflation of Tyres, Balls & Airbeds
